settings.notes: Keep everyday essentials easy to find. Set aside specialist orders for the GM to review.

Personality: Practical roadside innkeeper; checks boots and road conditions before asking for news.
Suggested greeting: Food first, then tell me how the road is.

Specialities:
- Pork Hand Pie
- Bread and Cheese Bundle

Known For:
- Fast hot meals
- Packed lunches prepared early

Optional Stories — edit or remove before play; these are suggestions, not established campaign facts:
- A wagoner has asked to be woken before dawn.
- A milestone was found in the ditch nearby.

Trading notes:
- Confirm rooms, stalls, kitchen hours and delivery arrangements before approval.
- Stable Horse excludes feed. Meal services do not create additional food Items.
- Do not charge for the same included food twice.
- Daily restock is a preference, not an automated schedule.
- Configure actual room names and doors before enabling optional room integrations.
Carry portable goods. Confirm bulky purchases and special orders before agreeing to delivery.
Issue practical supplies for approved work. The GM decides eligibility and any aid or discount.

Repairs farm tools and fittings first. Fine arms and fitted armour are ordered from a larger forge.
Suggested greeting: Welcome. Show me the worn part before we talk replacements.
Services commission work; completion and mechanical changes require GM adjudication.

Appointments and careful fitting take precedence over quick sales. Premium armour is never promised without a fitting.
Suggested greeting: Let us start with how it fits across your shoulders.
Services commission work; completion and mechanical changes require GM adjudication.

Keeps practical replacement equipment in standard patterns. The GM decides who is permitted to buy; the preset does not enforce rank or affiliation.
Suggested greeting: Name your requirement. I will check the rack.
Services commission work; completion and mechanical changes require GM adjudication.

Carries portable tools and repair materials. Heavy suits and large weapons are ordered rather than carried.
Suggested greeting: Small repairs today; larger work when I reach a proper forge.

Maintains a varied rack of weapons and armour. Special orders require workshop time.
Suggested greeting: Something off the rack, or work on what you have?
